en.combination: Multiline call × region directive on an argument line × statement-level diagnostic aggregation
en.validation: Validation checks next-line targeting around grouping tokens and multiline calls. Step 58 also prints an internal-region case and describes statement-wide suppression, but that observation was not retained as an effective assertion constraining the final failing test_058 path.

en.evaluation: In cancelled_session_jobs_are_skipped_but_unrelated_jobs_still_run, sessionTick is 1 instead of 0.

en.evaluation: Failures include the core error-state representation, an uncancelled older request signal, and a real prompt not showing API unavailable / unavailable.
en.combination: Async failure or exhausted retries × error display from core state to the prompt UI
en.validation: Core validation checks only loadError/fallback lists. Wrapper validation covers successful submission and loading/too-short states, but does not assert specific error text after failure.
en.counterfactual: Drive a real prompt with the tested failing resolver, asserting error display in the current frame while preserving fallback. This could locate information lost between core and wrapper and improve some F2P tests. The exact text-display contract still needs checking against the implementation.

en.evaluation: Between retries, loadError is fail instead of undefined. An older AbortController is also not cancelled, and six P2P snapshots fail.
en.combination: A failed request entering its retry wait × intermediate loading and loadError states
en.validation: The retry × new-input case checks attempt counts and cancellation, but does not ensure that a terminal error stays hidden while retries remain.
en.counterfactual: Between the first failure and the next retry, assert loading=true and no terminal loadError. This could guide delayed error publication and improve one F2P test; it does not establish a fix for the known path regressions.

zh.evaluation: SWR 即时旧值及刷新新值、retry 时序、最短 loading 的界面检查失败，另有空字符串与 undefined 的状态差异。
zh.combination: SWR 缓存命中 × 非零 debounce × 刷新前后列表观察
zh.validation: 原 SWR 测试在输入后先等 50ms 才检查，跳过了要求即时供给缓存的窗口。
zh.counterfactual: 在推进时钟前观察缓存，再在刷新完成后检查新列表，可以暴露延迟 cache 读取或更新的问题，可能改善 SWR 相关 F2P；当前简略断言差异不足以将全部时序失败归于同一原因。

en.evaluation: Checks fail for immediate SWR stale values, refreshed values, retry timing and minimum-loading UI behavior. There is also an empty-string versus undefined state difference.
en.combination: SWR cache hit × nonzero debounce × list observations before and after refresh
en.validation: The SWR test waits 50ms after input before inspecting results, skipping the window in which cached data should be supplied immediately.
en.counterfactual: Inspect cached values before advancing the clock, then the new list after refresh completes. This could expose delayed cache reads or updates and improve SWR F2P tests. The brief assertion differences do not justify attributing all timing failures to one cause.

en.counterfactual: Give the last of two background layers a color, assert color as a single value, then compress it with the layer lists. Feedback could guide separation of color from per-layer fields and improve three F2P tests.

zh.evaluation: IANA New York 被写为 Eastern，默认 rrulestr 往返失去正确时区。
zh.combination: IANA tzfile × 时区别名登记 × 无额外 tzids 的序列化往返
zh.validation: 原映射、混合时区和往返输入很多，但未有效区分别名下可解析与默认解析器可恢复。
zh.counterfactual: 固定 IANA 时区，用默认 rrulestr 读取 str(rule) 并比较 aware 序列，可促使保留可恢复的 TZID；可能改善部分 F2P。别名登记状态对具体失败的影响仍需隔离，保留条件判断。

en.evaluation: IANA New York is serialized as Eastern, and a default rrulestr round trip loses the correct timezone.
en.combination: IANA tzfile × timezone-alias registration × serialization round trip without extra tzids
en.validation: Validation includes many mapping, mixed-timezone and round-trip inputs, but does not effectively distinguish resolving through an alias from recovery by the default parser.
en.counterfactual: Fix an IANA timezone, parse str(rule) with default rrulestr, and compare aware sequences. This could guide retention of a recoverable TZID and improve some F2P tests. Alias-registry state still needs isolation as a cause, so the judgment is conditional.

overview.zh: 改进 dateutil 重复规则的 RFC5545 时区解析、TZID 序列化和往返兼容性。
overview.en: Improve RFC5545 timezone parsing, TZID serialization and round-trip interoperability for dateutil recurrence rules.

zh.evaluation: 大量 SQL 比较失败集中在 over 括号内空格、lag/lead 默认 offset 是否显式输出。
zh.validation: 已对多方言、完整窗口、命名窗口进行联合编译检查。
zh.counterfactual: 先统一 SQL 输出契约及默认参数形式；这些日志没有支持补 named-window 组合可改善当前失败的联系。

en.evaluation: Many SQL comparisons fail over spaces inside over parentheses and whether lag/lead explicitly emit the default offset.
en.validation: Joint compilation checks already cover multiple dialects, complete windows and named windows.
en.counterfactual: Align the SQL-output contract and default-argument representation first. These logs do not establish that an additional named-window combination would improve the current failures.

overview.zh: 为 Drizzle ORM 增加多 SQL 方言的窗口函数构造器、窗口定义及类型支持。
overview.en: Add window-function builders, window definitions and type support across Drizzle ORM SQL dialects.

zh.evaluation: 省略 mode 时 requiredIf 的 Zod 解析判断为 true，评测要求 false。
zh.combination: requiredIf 条件 × parser 默认 mode × 属性必填性
zh.validation: 显式 mode 的测试没有约束省略参数的实际入口，undefined 进入不同分支。
zh.counterfactual: 同一 schema 对比省略 mode 与显式默认 mode，核对必填与错误结果，可指导在入口统一 mode，可能提高 F2P。

en.evaluation: With mode omitted, requiredIf Zod parsing returns true where evaluation expects false.
en.combination: A requiredIf condition × the parser's default mode × attribute requiredness
en.validation: Explicit-mode tests do not constrain the actual entry point with the option omitted. undefined enters a different branch.
en.counterfactual: Compare omitted mode with the explicit default mode on the same schema, checking requiredness and errors. This could guide mode normalization at the entry point and improve F2P.

overview.zh: 为 DynamoDB Toolbox 增加条件必填属性，并在解析、DTO 和 schema 导出中保持一致。
overview.en: Add conditional attribute requirements to DynamoDB Toolbox with consistent parsing, DTO and schema exports.

evaluation_terms: parser Zod schema enforces conditional requirements

zh.evaluation: 两项 OpenAPI SSE 响应的媒体类型或 schema 缺失；另有流字节和普通 handle 错误。
zh.combination: SSE endpoint × success schema × OpenAPI 响应生成
zh.validation: 已用同一 SSE endpoint 与 withSSE(Event) 打印 OpenAPI；为纠正 error 响应媒体类型撤回 endpoint 分支后，success 也变为 application/json，未形成同时约束 success SSE 与 error JSON 的有效断言。
zh.counterfactual: 给 SSE endpoint 配已有 schema，生成规范后核对 text/event-stream 与 schema 引用，能指向 OpenAPI 分支的识别/传播问题，可能改善部分 F2P。

en.evaluation: Two OpenAPI SSE responses lack the media type or schema. Stream bytes and ordinary handle behavior also fail.
en.combination: An SSE endpoint × its success schema × OpenAPI response generation
en.validation: The same SSE endpoint with withSSE(Event) was used to print OpenAPI output. After reverting the endpoint branch to correct error-response media types, the success response also became application/json, without an effective assertion jointly requiring SSE success and JSON errors.
en.counterfactual: Give an SSE endpoint an existing schema, generate the specification, and check text/event-stream plus the schema reference. This could locate recognition/propagation failures in OpenAPI branches and improve some F2P tests.

overview.zh: 为 Effect HttpApi 增加 SSE 端点、流转换、事件解析及 OpenAPI 表示。
overview.en: Add SSE endpoints, stream conversion, event decoding and OpenAPI representation to Effect HttpApi.

evaluation_terms: SSE endpoint uses text/event-stream content type
SSE endpoint response schema is a union referencing event types

zh.evaluation: toResponse 无 status；无效 JSON 抛 SyntaxError 而非 ParseError；普通 handle 及事件 tag 也失败。
zh.validation: 部分测试只构造了惰性 Effect，没有实际执行；其余 union/stream 检查的输出契约不一致。
zh.counterfactual: 需要先确认 toResponse/事件和 ParseError 的公开返回契约，再把实际运行的失败与联合路径绑定。仅凭多个 API 同时失败，不确认组合归因。

en.evaluation: toResponse has no status; invalid JSON throws SyntaxError rather than ParseError. Ordinary handle and event-tag tests also fail.
en.validation: Some tests only construct lazy Effect values without executing them. Other union/stream checks use inconsistent output contracts.
en.counterfactual: Clarify public return contracts for toResponse/events and ParseError, then connect executed failures to joint paths. Multiple APIs failing together does not establish combination attribution.

overview.zh: 为 Effect HttpApi 增加 SSE 端点、流转换、事件解析及 OpenAPI 表示。
overview.en: Add SSE endpoints, stream conversion, event decoding and OpenAPI representation to Effect HttpApi.

evaluation_terms: toResponse produces a streaming response with SSE headers
toStream fails with ParseError when SSE data contains invalid JSON

zh.evaluation: 流输出非 bytes、toResponse 无 status、SSE 标志和 schema annotation 缺失，以及普通 handle decode 失败。
zh.validation: 普通 handle 输入已有执行；若干惰性测试未运行，不能充当通过证据。
zh.counterfactual: 应先修接口表示和执行边界；当前没有具体证据说明补 context/外层错误检查会帮助这些失败。

en.evaluation: Stream output is not bytes, toResponse lacks status, SSE flags and schema annotations are absent, and ordinary handle decoding fails.
en.validation: Ordinary handle inputs were executed. Several lazy tests never run and therefore provide no passing evidence.
en.counterfactual: Repair interface representation and execution boundaries first. No concrete evidence connects additional context or outer-error checks to these failures.

overview.zh: 为 Effect HttpApi 增加 SSE 端点、流转换、事件解析及 OpenAPI 表示。
overview.en: Add SSE endpoints, stream conversion, event decoding and OpenAPI representation to Effect HttpApi.

evaluation_terms: fromStream converts a typed Stream to a Stream of Uint8Array SSE bytes
toResponse produces a streaming response with SSE headers

zh.evaluation: 三项 XML merge 将独立的兄弟增加与文本修改报为冲突。
zh.combination: 同父节点的独立编辑 × 冲突分类器后续修改 × 最终版本复验
zh.validation: 45 的 /tmp/dbg3.go 已检查该类关系并通过；50/97 后分类器改变，未保留有效复验。
zh.counterfactual: 在末版恢复此回归并同时断言无冲突及两项修改都保留，可暴露过宽的冲突范围，可能改善 F2P。另有未运行 P2P，不将其算作此语义缺陷。

en.evaluation: Three XML merge tests classify independent sibling additions and text edits as conflicts.
en.combination: Independent edits under one parent × later conflict-classifier changes × revalidation of the final implementation
en.validation: /tmp/dbg3.go at step 45 checks this relationship and passes. The classifier changes after steps 50/97, without effective retained revalidation.
en.counterfactual: Restore the regression on the final implementation, asserting both absence of conflicts and preservation of both edits. This could expose overly broad conflict ranges and improve F2P. Unexecuted P2P tests are not counted as this semantic defect.

overview.zh: 为 etree 增加 XML 差异、补丁应用及三方合并，处理独立修改和冲突。
overview.en: Add XML differences, patch application and three-way merging to etree, handling independent edits and conflicts.

zh.evaluation: IgnoreWhitespace=true 时仍产生一个差异。
zh.validation: 原节点拷贝及多编辑操作已联合验证；实际失败落在空白归一化的直接功能。
zh.counterfactual: 检查并修正 IgnoreWhitespace 规范化可能改善 F2P，但当前未建立与操作组合的联系。

en.evaluation: One difference remains when IgnoreWhitespace=true.
en.validation: Node copying and multiple editing operations were validated together. The actual failure concerns direct whitespace-normalization behavior.
en.counterfactual: Checking and correcting IgnoreWhitespace normalization could improve F2P, but no connection to combinations of editing operations has been established.

overview.zh: 为 etree 增加 XML 差异、补丁应用及三方合并，处理独立修改和冲突。
overview.en: Add XML differences, patch application and three-way merging to etree, handling independent edits and conflicts.

zh.evaluation: Go 函数 panic 字符串 type mismatch，被 errtype 判为 custom，评测要求 type。
zh.validation: 原 try/catch 和类型分类已联测；评测用文本模拟 type error，不能等同真实 Go 类型异常。
zh.counterfactual: 需先确认 errtype 是否必须按任意 panic 字符串启发式分类。未确定这项契约前，不把换一段文本称为确认组合缺口。

en.evaluation: A Go function panics with the string type mismatch. errtype classifies it as custom, while evaluation expects type.
en.validation: try/catch and type classification were tested together. Evaluation simulates a type error with text; that is not equivalent to an actual Go type exception.
en.counterfactual: Clarify whether errtype must heuristically classify arbitrary panic strings. Until that contract is established, changing the text does not demonstrate a confirmed combination gap.

overview.zh: 为 Expr 增加 try/catch、抛错、重试和错误分类等异常处理能力。
overview.en: Add exception handling to Expr, including try/catch, throwing, retries and error classification.

zh.evaluation: try(items[0],0)+try(items[1],10) 在右侧报 unknown name try。
zh.combination: try 表达式 × 二元运算右操作数的解析入口
zh.validation: 已有顶层及左侧 try，不能覆盖右侧走到的另一语法入口。
zh.counterfactual: 同一运算中放两个 try，并核对编译与求值，可暴露关键词识别依赖位置的问题。可能改善该 F2P，即使其余 error 字符串/分类仍失败。

en.evaluation: try(items[0],0)+try(items[1],10) reports unknown name try on the right-hand side.
en.combination: A try expression × the parser entry point for a binary operation's right operand
en.validation: Top-level and left-hand try expressions were tested, but do not cover the different syntax entry reached on the right.
en.counterfactual: Place two try expressions in one operation and check compilation plus evaluation. This could expose position-dependent keyword recognition and improve this F2P result even if other error-string/classification failures remain.

overview.zh: 为 Expr 增加 try/catch、抛错、重试和错误分类等异常处理能力。
overview.en: Add exception handling to Expr, including try/catch, throwing, retries and error classification.

zh.evaluation: catch 错误经表达式 string(err) 后输出带内部字段的结构串，而非原错误消息。
zh.combination: throw/捕获后的错误对象 × 既有 string 内建函数
zh.validation: 原返回错误对象或在 Go 外部打印的检查，不能证明表达式内部转换保留 Error/Stringer 行为。
zh.counterfactual: 在 catch 内调用 string(err)，对比已知 throw 消息而非 Go 外部 fmt 输出，能指导保留错误接口或修转换分支，可能改善部分 F2P。

en.evaluation: Calling string(err) inside the expression after catch returns a struct string containing internal fields rather than the original error message.
en.combination: A thrown/caught error object × the existing string built-in
en.validation: Returning an error object or printing it externally in Go does not establish that in-expression conversion preserves Error/Stringer behavior.
en.counterfactual: Call string(err) inside catch and compare with the known thrown message rather than external Go fmt output. This could guide preservation of error interfaces or repair of conversion logic and improve some F2P tests.

overview.zh: 为 Expr 增加 try/catch、抛错、重试和错误分类等异常处理能力。
overview.en: Add exception handling to Expr, including try/catch, throwing, retries and error classification.

zh.evaluation: 多个 string(err) 结果带结构字段；另有 retry 返回 nil 和分类错误。
zh.combination: 异常绑定到 catch 变量 × Expr 内建 string 消费
zh.validation: 原辅助函数在 Go 层读取/打印错误，不等价于语言内建转换的消费者。
zh.counterfactual: 用 throw('test error') 后 catch/string 的精确消息断言，可使 agent 修复错误对象转换。仅主张可能提高相关 F2P，不把 retry 全部归为同因。

en.evaluation: Several string(err) results include struct fields; retry also returns nil and classification fails.
en.combination: An exception bound to a catch variable × consumption by Expr's built-in string
en.validation: Helpers read or print errors in Go, which is not equivalent to the language's built-in conversion consuming them.
en.counterfactual: Throw 'test error', then assert the exact message from catch/string. This could help repair error-object conversion and improve relevant F2P tests; it does not attribute all retry failures to the same cause.

overview.zh: 为 Expr 增加 try/catch、抛错、重试和错误分类等异常处理能力。
overview.en: Add exception handling to Expr, including try/catch, throwing, retries and error classification.

zh.evaluation: 未弃用路由出现在统计中且计数为零，评测期望不出现。
zh.validation: 125/126 已检查并明确接受这些零条目；同一结果不是未观察。
zh.counterfactual: 原普通 route 访问后产生零统计条目的行为已检查；当前差异集中于 stats 是否省略零条目的直接表示契约，未建立两个独立功能的交互原因。需先明确该 API 约定。

en.evaluation: A nondeprecated route appears in statistics with a zero count; evaluation expects it to be absent.
en.validation: Steps 125/126 inspect and explicitly accept these zero entries. The result was observed.
en.counterfactual: The zero statistics entry after accessing an ordinary route was already checked. The difference concerns the direct representation contract of stats—whether to omit zero entries. No interaction between two independent features has been established; clarify this API contract first.

overview.zh: 为 FastAPI 增加弃用和 Sunset 响应头、路由继承、OpenAPI 信息及访问统计。
overview.en: Add deprecation and Sunset response headers, route inheritance, OpenAPI metadata and hit statistics to FastAPI.

zh.evaluation: 三级 include 的 sunset 得到 2030，而评测要求内层 include 指定的 2031。
zh.combination: 内层 include 显式 override × 路由扁平化 × 外层再次 include
zh.validation: 原多层默认/显式路由验证很多，但对已经由内层 include 固化的值与外层参数的优先级，没有与评测一致的有效约束。
zh.counterfactual: 三层使用不同日期，跟踪每层来源并检查响应头/OpenAPI，可暴露扁平化丢失来源的问题。可能改善 F2P；内外 include 优先级必须依据公共契约确认，故为有条件正例。

en.evaluation: With three levels of include, sunset is 2030; evaluation expects the inner include's explicit 2031 value.
en.combination: An explicit inner-include override × route flattening × subsequent outer inclusion
en.validation: Validation covers many multilevel defaults and explicit route settings, but does not effectively constrain precedence between a value already fixed by an inner include and outer parameters as evaluation expects.
en.counterfactual: Use different dates at three levels, track their sources, and inspect response headers/OpenAPI. This could expose provenance lost during flattening and improve F2P. Inner/outer include precedence must be checked against the public contract, making this a conditional positive.

overview.zh: 为 FastAPI 增加弃用和 Sunset 响应头、路由继承、OpenAPI 信息及访问统计。
overview.en: Add deprecation and Sunset response headers, route inheritance, OpenAPI metadata and hit statistics to FastAPI.

zh.evaluation: 唯一失败为多级 include override：最终 sunset 选择外层日期。
zh.combination: 嵌套 include 的已生效参数 × 再包含时的优先级
zh.validation: 原异常头和继承检查没有建立内层 include 值的来源保持断言。
zh.counterfactual: 让内外 include 都覆盖且使用可区分日期，核对最终路由实际响应，可指导保留最近一次内层有效设置；可能改善唯一 F2P，优先级解释边界与上一例同样明示。

en.evaluation: The only failure is a multilevel include override: final sunset selects the outer date.
en.combination: Parameters already applied by a nested include × precedence during another inclusion
en.validation: Exception-header and inheritance checks do not establish preservation of an inner include value's source.
en.counterfactual: Give both inner and outer includes overrides with distinguishable dates and inspect the final route's actual response. This could guide retention of the nearest effective inner setting and improve the only F2P failure. The precedence interpretation remains conditional.

overview.zh: 为 FastAPI 增加弃用和 Sunset 响应头、路由继承、OpenAPI 信息及访问统计。
overview.en: Add deprecation and Sunset response headers, route inheritance, OpenAPI metadata and hit statistics to FastAPI.

zh.evaluation: reset 统计后仍有 /items 的零计数，评测要求空字典。
zh.validation: 原请求后 reset 已执行，区别是重置后的表示约定。
zh.counterfactual: 核对 reset 是清空登记还是只清计数；这是已有状态操作的契约差异，未证实遗漏新的交互。

en.evaluation: After statistics reset, /items remains with a zero count; evaluation expects an empty dictionary.
en.validation: A request followed by reset was executed. The difference is the representation contract after resetting.
en.counterfactual: Clarify whether reset removes registrations or only clears counters. This is a contract difference for an existing state operation, not an established missing interaction.

overview.zh: 为 FastAPI 增加可继承配置的隐式 HEAD 和 OPTIONS 方法及相关统计和 OpenAPI 信息。
overview.en: Add configurable inherited implicit HEAD/OPTIONS methods to FastAPI with related statistics and OpenAPI metadata.

zh.evaluation: nested auto_head/auto_options 都返回 405，评测要求内层 include 的 True 生效并返回 200。
zh.combination: 内层 include=True × 外层 include=False × 隐式方法生成
zh.validation: 原深层和重复包含均测试过；缺少有效区分已由内层 include 设置的值和外层缺省/覆盖来源。
zh.counterfactual: 使用内外相反设置并检查 HEAD、OPTIONS 实际请求，可能指导保留参数来源并改善两项 F2P。最近值的优先级仍需与公开层级约定核实，故不称确定根因。

en.evaluation: Nested auto_head/auto_options requests both return 405. Evaluation expects the inner include's True to apply and return 200.
en.combination: Inner include=True × outer include=False × implicit-method generation
en.validation: Deep and repeated inclusions were tested, but there is no effective distinction between a value already set by an inner include and the source of outer defaults/overrides.
en.counterfactual: Use opposite inner/outer settings and make actual HEAD and OPTIONS requests. This could guide preservation of parameter provenance and improve two F2P tests. Check nearest-value precedence against the public hierarchy contract before treating it as a confirmed cause.

overview.zh: 为 FastAPI 增加可继承配置的隐式 HEAD 和 OPTIONS 方法及相关统计和 OpenAPI 信息。
overview.en: Add configurable inherited implicit HEAD/OPTIONS methods to FastAPI with related statistics and OpenAPI metadata.

zh.evaluation: 两项 nested nearest value 失败；另五项 operations 列表/字典形状不一致。
zh.combination: 嵌套 include 冲突设置 × 自动 HEAD/OPTIONS 注册
zh.validation: 原响应及 OpenAPI 测试广泛，但未给出该内外相反设置下可判别的来源保持检查；operations 形状已有自定期望。
zh.counterfactual: 补内层 True、外层 False 的实际请求对照，可能修正两项 F2P；不将 operations 接口形状纳入组合收益，优先级保留契约边界。

en.evaluation: Two nested nearest-value checks fail. Five other failures concern operations being a list versus a dictionary.
en.combination: Conflicting nested-include settings × automatic HEAD/OPTIONS registration
en.validation: Response and OpenAPI tests are broad, but lack a discriminating source-preservation check for these opposite settings. The operations shape already has a test-specific expectation.
en.counterfactual: Compare actual requests with inner True and outer False to potentially repair two F2P tests. The operations interface shape is not included in the combination benefit; precedence retains a public-contract caveat.

overview.zh: 为 FastAPI 增加可继承配置的隐式 HEAD 和 OPTIONS 方法及相关统计和 OpenAPI 信息。
overview.en: Add configurable inherited implicit HEAD/OPTIONS methods to FastAPI with related statistics and OpenAPI metadata.

zh.evaluation: 自然排序前导零等值项顺序与评测相反。
zh.combination: 自然排序数字段数值相等（file7/file007）× 所有键相等时的 path 回退
zh.validation: 原已测 leading zeros，却按不同长度优先的顺序接受，未有效检查数字段相等后必须进入最终回退。
zh.counterfactual: 选数值相等但 raw path 次序与零位数次序相反的名称，明确断言最终 path tie-break，可指导自然比较返回相等而交给回退，提高唯一 F2P。

en.evaluation: Numerically equal natural-sort entries with leading zeros appear in the opposite order to evaluation's expectation.
en.combination: Numerically equal natural-sort segments (file7/file007) × final path fallback when all keys tie
en.validation: Leading zeros were tested, but the accepted order prioritizes different segment lengths. It does not effectively enforce final fallback when numeric segments are equal.
en.counterfactual: Choose names with equal numeric values whose raw-path order opposes leading-zero-length order, and assert the final path tie-break. This could guide the natural comparator to return equality and defer to fallback, improving the only F2P failure.

overview.zh: 为 fd 增加确定性的多键排序，包括自然排序、反向排序和路径兜底比较。
overview.en: Add deterministic multikey sorting to fd, including natural order, reverse order and a final path tie-break.

zh.evaluation: AmbiguousEmbed.Conflict 应报告 unresolved，却没有诊断；另有无 import 的标准库链接差异。
zh.combination: 两个嵌入类型同名成员 × 文档成员链接解析
zh.validation: 原单一合法嵌入成员被检查，递归找到任一同名项不能证明无歧义。
zh.counterfactual: 用两个嵌入成员共享 Conflict，和单一成员正例对照，核对诊断，可指导按 Go 成员唯一性解析，提高相关 F2P。

en.evaluation: AmbiguousEmbed.Conflict should produce an unresolved diagnostic but does not. There is also a difference for standard-library links without imports.
en.combination: Same-named members in two embedded types × documentation member-link resolution
en.validation: A valid member from a single embedded type is checked. Recursively finding any same-named member does not establish unambiguous resolution.
en.counterfactual: Compare two embedded members sharing Conflict with a single-member positive case and inspect diagnostics. This could guide resolution according to Go member uniqueness and improve relevant F2P tests.

overview.zh: 为 go-critic 增加 Go 文档链接检查器，解析包、类型和成员并诊断无效链接。
overview.en: Add a Go documentation-link checker to go-critic that resolves packages, types and members and reports invalid links.

zh.evaluation: 若干无 import 标准库名称、缺失别名成员和 Missing 链接未报告。
zh.validation: 原 alias、dot import、完整路径、self package、generic 与成员检查均运行过，且部分反馈已修。
zh.counterfactual: 需进一步隔离文档解析是否将这些文本认作链接，以及文件作用域查找的前提。不能仅凭漏报名称把所有导入/成员组合再称漏测。

en.evaluation: Several unimported standard-library names, missing alias members and Missing links receive no diagnostic.
en.validation: Alias imports, dot imports, full paths, the current package, generics and members were checked, and some feedback led to repairs.
en.counterfactual: Further isolate whether the documentation parser recognizes these texts as links and what file-scope lookup assumes. Missing diagnostics alone do not establish that all import/member combinations were untested.

overview.zh: 为 go-critic 增加 Go 文档链接检查器，解析包、类型和成员并诊断无效链接。
overview.en: Add a Go documentation-link checker to go-critic that resolves packages, types and members and reports invalid links.

zh.evaluation: BlockGhost 位于块式 doc comment 中，却没有 unresolved 诊断。
zh.combination: 块式文档注释 × unresolved 符号链接检查
zh.validation: 原合法/非法链接主要在 // 文档中；实现跳过 /* 的路径，未以同样链接比较两种注释载体。
zh.counterfactual: 将已知不存在符号放入合法块式 doc，并检查诊断与行注释一致，能暴露入口过滤，可能改善部分 F2P；不把 suite 父项另算独立缺陷。

en.evaluation: BlockGhost in a block-style doc comment receives no unresolved diagnostic.
en.combination: Block-style documentation comments × unresolved-symbol link checks
en.validation: Valid/invalid link validation mainly uses // comments. The implementation skips the /* path, without comparing the same link in both comment forms.
en.counterfactual: Place a known nonexistent symbol in a valid block doc comment and assert the same diagnostic as for a line comment. This could expose entry filtering and improve some F2P tests. A parent suite failure is not counted as a separate defect.

overview.zh: 为 go-critic 增加 Go 文档链接检查器，解析包、类型和成员并诊断无效链接。
overview.en: Add a Go documentation-link checker to go-critic that resolves packages, types and members and reports invalid links.

zh.evaluation: 无 import 的 strings.NewReader 与 strings.Replacer.Replace 解析政策和评测不一致。
zh.validation: 原标准库及成员链接已有检查，自动补全标准库与严格文件 import 的边界未统一。
zh.counterfactual: 先明确不导入包时 doc 链接能否解析；当前不能确认新增 alias 碰撞测试会指导修复该政策差异。

en.evaluation: Resolution policy for unimported strings.NewReader and strings.Replacer.Replace differs from evaluation.
en.validation: Standard-library and member links were checked. The boundary between automatic standard-library resolution and strict file imports is unsettled.
en.counterfactual: Clarify whether doc links may resolve packages without imports. It is not established that adding alias-collision tests would guide repair of this policy difference.

overview.zh: 为 go-critic 增加 Go 文档链接检查器，解析包、类型和成员并诊断无效链接。
overview.en: Add a Go documentation-link checker to go-critic that resolves packages, types and members and reports invalid links.

zh.evaluation: ComplexOverlap/OverlappingRegions 未产生所需冲突或冲突标记。
zh.combination: 两个分支编辑起点不同 × 区间部分重叠 × worktree merge
zh.validation: 原同起点及不相交编辑不足以检验一般区间交叠。
zh.counterfactual: 构造不同起点但覆盖范围相交的修改，核对冲突返回及 worktree 标记，可指导按区间而非起点判断，可能改善 F2P。

en.evaluation: ComplexOverlap/OverlappingRegions do not produce the required conflict or conflict markers.
en.combination: Two branches with different edit starting points × partially overlapping ranges × worktree merge
en.validation: Same-start and disjoint edits do not test general interval overlap.
en.counterfactual: Construct edits with different starts but intersecting ranges, then inspect the conflict return and worktree markers. This could guide comparison of ranges rather than starts and improve F2P.

overview.zh: 为 go-git Worktree 增加快进和三方合并，并记录冲突、索引状态和合并提交。
overview.en: Add fast-forward and three-way merges to go-git Worktree with conflicts, index state and merge commits.

zh.evaluation: BlobRetryStopsOnContextCancel 的审计尝试数为 0，评测要求至少 1。
zh.combination: blob 发布失败后的重试 × context 取消 × 尝试审计
zh.validation: 原 HTTP 取消与重试检查不能约束 blob 分支在取消前记录已开始的尝试。
zh.counterfactual: 在 blob 首次调用发生后再取消，检查停止重试且已发生尝试被审计，可帮助修复遗漏记录，提高该 F2P；日志未充分隔离取消实际时点，故保留条件。

en.evaluation: BlobRetryStopsOnContextCancel records 0 audit attempts, while evaluation requires at least 1.
en.combination: Retries after blob publication failure × context cancellation × attempt auditing
en.validation: HTTP cancellation/retry checks do not constrain the blob branch to record an attempt already started before cancellation.
en.counterfactual: Cancel after the first blob call, asserting that retries stop and the attempt already made is audited. This could guide repair of missing records and improve this F2P result. Logs do not fully isolate actual cancellation timing, so the judgment remains conditional.

overview.zh: 为 GoReleaser 的多种发布后端增加按制品重试和确定性的尝试审计。
overview.en: Add per-artifact retries and deterministic attempt auditing across GoReleaser publication backends.

zh.evaluation: 2/17 F2P；多个普通与嵌套增量响应均为空，另有 DSL 类型和 unsupported transport 失败。
zh.validation: 原 validation 已包含真实 HTTP、嵌套 defer/stream；不能把空响应统称缺少嵌套输入。
zh.counterfactual: 需先区分 transport 入口、载荷分派和结果组装的共同阻断；目前未建立中段插入测试到这些失败的修复路径。

en.evaluation: F2P is 2/17. Many ordinary and nested incremental responses are empty; DSL-type and unsupported-transport tests also fail.
en.validation: Agent validation includes real HTTP and nested defer/stream cases. Empty responses cannot all be described as missing nested inputs.
en.counterfactual: Distinguish shared blockage at transport entry, payload dispatch and result assembly first. No repair path has been established from an additional middle-insertion test to these failures.

overview.zh: 为 gql 增加 GraphQL @defer/@stream 增量交付，累积结果并支持 HTTP、WebSocket 和 DSL。
overview.en: Add GraphQL @defer/@stream incremental delivery to gql with accumulated results and HTTP, WebSocket and DSL support.

zh.evaluation: 17/17 F2P；仅不支持 incremental 的 transport 应拒绝却未拒绝，损失 P2P。
zh.validation: 增量列表与嵌套更新已实际运行；本次失败是 transport 能力前置检查。
zh.counterfactual: 补能力检查可能恢复该 P2P，但尚无证据表明列表组合是其原因。

en.evaluation: All 17 F2P tests pass. Only an unsupported transport fails to reject incremental execution, losing P2P.
en.validation: Incremental lists and nested updates were executed. The present failure is a transport-capability precondition.
en.counterfactual: Adding the capability check might recover this P2P test, but no evidence links the list combination to its cause.

overview.zh: 为 gql 增加 GraphQL @defer/@stream 增量交付，累积结果并支持 HTTP、WebSocket 和 DSL。
overview.en: Add GraphQL @defer/@stream incremental delivery to gql with accumulated results and HTTP, WebSocket and DSL support.

zh.evaluation: 3/17 F2P；不同增量场景普遍产生空数据，unsupported transport 回归亦在。
zh.validation: 原真实 HTTP 和嵌套 defer/stream 验证已执行，不能仅据失败名称认定这些输入缺失。
zh.counterfactual: 尚需定位共享入口与增量合并之间的阻断；无法从现有窗口确认补列表位置测试会改善本次结果。

en.evaluation: F2P is 3/17. Empty data occur widely across incremental scenarios, and the unsupported-transport regression is also present.
en.validation: Real HTTP and nested defer/stream validation were executed. Failure names alone do not establish absent inputs.
en.counterfactual: Locate the blockage between shared entry points and incremental merging. Available evidence does not establish that adding list-position tests would improve this result.

overview.zh: 为 gql 增加 GraphQL @defer/@stream 增量交付，累积结果并支持 HTTP、WebSocket 和 DSL。
overview.en: Add GraphQL @defer/@stream incremental delivery to gql with accumulated results and HTTP, WebSocket and DSL support.

zh.evaluation: 17/17 F2P；仅 unsupported transport 的 P2P 未抛预期错误。
zh.validation: 原已经验证增量错误及多个更新路径，评测的新功能项全过。
zh.counterfactual: 需要恢复 transport 能力约束；不能仅据覆盖遗漏推断其能改善该 P2P。

en.evaluation: All 17 F2P tests pass. Only the unsupported-transport P2P test fails to raise the expected error.
en.validation: Incremental errors and multiple update paths were validated. All evaluated new-feature cases pass.
en.counterfactual: Restore transport-capability constraints. A coverage omission alone does not establish that it could improve this P2P result.

overview.zh: 为 gql 增加 GraphQL @defer/@stream 增量交付，累积结果并支持 HTTP、WebSocket 和 DSL。
overview.en: Add GraphQL @defer/@stream incremental delivery to gql with accumulated results and HTTP, WebSocket and DSL support.

zh.evaluation: threshold 测试在目标矩形变化后的第二次异步回调超时。
zh.combination: 已 observe 的目标 × 几何跨阈值 × 无显式 scroll/重新 observe 的后续采样
zh.validation: 原改变样式并触发事件或 takeRecords；未有效检查仅改变几何后自动产生下一次通知。
zh.counterfactual: 首次通知后只改变目标矩形，等待并断言阈值跨越，可暴露采样触发缺失，可能改善 F2P。需求要求阈值变化通知，但具体轮询契约仍有边界。

en.evaluation: The threshold test times out awaiting the second async callback after the target rectangle changes.
en.combination: An already observed target × geometry crossing a threshold × subsequent sampling without explicit scroll or observe calls
en.validation: Validation changes styles and triggers events or takeRecords. It does not effectively check that geometry changes alone automatically produce the next notification.
en.counterfactual: After the first notification, change only the target rectangle and await/assert the threshold crossing. This could expose missing sampling triggers and improve F2P. The requirement calls for threshold-change notification, but the precise polling contract remains open to interpretation.

overview.zh: 为 Happy DOM 实现具有真实几何计算、阈值判断和异步通知的 IntersectionObserver。
overview.en: Implement IntersectionObserver in Happy DOM with real geometry, threshold checks and async delivery.

evaluation_terms: Detects threshold crossings in subsequent async delivery cycles.

zh.evaluation: threshold 后续回调超时。
zh.combination: 已注册 observer × 目标矩形跨阈值 × 没有外加事件
zh.validation: 原 scroll 和重新 observe 的输入不能判别自动几何更新是否有效。
zh.counterfactual: 保留 observer，在不 dispatch 的情况下改变矩形并检查第二次通知，可指导修复持续采样；可改善相关 F2P，触发机制的需求解释仍需保留条件。

en.evaluation: The later threshold callback times out.
en.combination: A registered observer × the target rectangle crossing a threshold × no externally dispatched event
en.validation: Inputs using scroll or repeated observe calls do not discriminate whether automatic geometry updates work.
en.counterfactual: Keep the observer, change the rectangle without dispatch, and check the second notification. This could guide repair of continuous sampling and improve relevant F2P tests, subject to the requirement's trigger interpretation.

overview.zh: 为 Happy DOM 实现具有真实几何计算、阈值判断和异步通知的 IntersectionObserver。
overview.en: Implement IntersectionObserver in Happy DOM with real geometry, threshold checks and async delivery.

evaluation_terms: Detects threshold crossings in subsequent async delivery cycles.

zh.evaluation: threshold 测试第二次通知超时。
zh.combination: observe 生命周期持续中 × 无 scroll 的几何变化 × threshold 判断
zh.validation: 原变化验证依赖 scroll，未独立观察无事件的变化。
zh.counterfactual: 补无事件变化的连续异步通知对照，可能促使 agent 修正触发方式并提高 F2P；不是断言任意轮询方式都由需求唯一规定。

en.evaluation: The threshold test times out awaiting its second notification.
en.combination: An ongoing observe lifecycle × geometry changes without scroll × threshold evaluation
en.validation: Change validation depends on scroll and does not independently observe event-free changes.
en.counterfactual: Compare consecutive async notifications after event-free changes. This could prompt repair of triggering and improve F2P; it does not imply that the requirement uniquely prescribes any particular polling mechanism.

overview.zh: 为 Happy DOM 实现具有真实几何计算、阈值判断和异步通知的 IntersectionObserver。
overview.en: Implement IntersectionObserver in Happy DOM with real geometry, threshold checks and async delivery.

evaluation_terms: Detects threshold crossings in subsequent async delivery cycles.

zh.evaluation: threshold、zero-area 与 rootMargin 场景均超时。
zh.combination: 持续观察 × 几何跨阈值 × 后续异步采样
zh.validation: 原把 root/target 插入文档并触发变化；评测部分对象未插入文档，且阈值变化未发事件。
zh.counterfactual: 补同一 observer 的无事件二次通知，有机会修复 threshold F2P。断开文档的 root/target 是否应视为相交另有契约边界，不把全部超时一并归因。

en.evaluation: Threshold, zero-area and rootMargin scenarios all time out.
en.combination: Continuous observation × geometry crossing a threshold × subsequent async sampling
en.validation: Validation attaches root/target to the document and triggers changes. Some evaluation objects are detached, and the threshold change dispatches no event.
en.counterfactual: Check an event-free second notification on the same observer, which might repair the threshold F2P case. Whether detached root/target elements should intersect is a separate contract question; the timeouts are not all attributed to this gap.
